[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Emotional Intelligence 2.0" by Travis Bradberry and Jean Greaves - Developing self-awareness and emotional intelligence.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "The 5 AM Club: Own Your Morning, Elevate Your Life" by Robin Sharma - Building a morning routine to boost productivity and self-awareness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Atomic Habits: An Easy & Proven Way to Build Good Habits & Break Bad Ones" by James Clear - A comprehensive guide to building good habits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "The Miracle Morning: The Not-So-Obvious Secret Guaranteed to Transform Your Life (Before 8AM)" by Hal Elrod - Creating a morning routine for success.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] "The 10X Rule: The Only Difference Between Success and Failure" by Grant Cardone - Setting and achieving big goals.
